scope: Read-only local source audit; no dependency or production changes
recommendation: Close the current-stack milestone after the bounded optimizer-resume fix; prepare a separate coherent dependency-chain branch. Do not present a vLLM/renderer/verifier pin bump as a small token-provenance feature.
concrete_breaks: Verifier b13 to3f142 changes708files; verifiers/v1/legacy.py and verifiers/envs v0 are deleted. Current EnvConfig(id=...), legacy dataset-row dispatch and joint run_group scoring rely on those APIs. Silently dropping them would break existing RG/legacy experiments and change group reward semantics.

New serve RunRequest requires task_data only. EnvClient assembles streamed trace deltas into WireEpisode; current cancellation/failure/no-trace accounting and group completion must be revalidated against actual streamed assembly, not a fabricated final Episode alone.
New Episode exposes last_error rather than current error used by episodes.from_episode; schema adaptation is required even for failed single-trace native runs.

Graph now distinguishes physical token_ids from renderer_token_ids/logical_ids, changes prefix matching and node construction, and carries trainability/weight streams/provenance. Value geometry must remain tied to actual model-token positions; logical renderer IDs cannot substitute for critic input indices.

Renderer bdb to052 changes89files, including reasoning-history retention, prefix-stability contracts, message/token ordering, Qwen/Nemotron formatting and parsing. Same message text does not establish identical tokens, action masks or private critic prefixes.

Pinned upstream target3c968 also moves transformers to5.19, torch>=2.13, vLLM>=0.32 and newer canonical package families. Exact old-kernel gradient equality should not be assumed across this backend transition; preserve independent semantic oracles and declare numerical tolerances from frozen controls before candidate acceptance.

Legacy removal is two concrete commits:91d4f69e6 removes the v1 bridge and native-v1 suffixes;66a606493 removes the remaining relocated v0 stack. By3f142 the package root exports only its version, so old vf.SingleTurnEnv/vf.XMLParser imports also require package migration.
bounded_next_branch_sequence: First inventory actually used native/legacy environment configurations and map them to maintained canonical tasksets. Preserve selected task payload, scoring, prompts, timeout/cancellation and joint-group behavior. Port used environments cleanly at their own package boundary; do not vendor a second legacy runtime into value code.

Adopt coherent canonical Episode/delta protocol and renderer stack with no token-age diagnostics yet. Reuse real two-worker task/payload/cancellation tests and exact LOO prompt/geometry oracles, adding only changed logical-vs-physical token boundary cases. Maintain original-trace-before-filter and critic publication before policy admission.

Validate the inference backend and tokenizer/reasoning contract on actual used models, with same ancestral sampling configuration and pinned tokenizer revisions. One real serving-to-training actor/critic acceptance is justified for this stack change; do not multiply unrelated model/rank grids.

Only after the coherent stack is sound, implement observational sampled-token version spans end to end. Keep group dispatch/critic replay provenance distinct; unknown remains unknown. Reuse reviewed streaming statistics for age bins; do not alter stale-group cancellation or masks.
value_invariants: Capture immutable original physical branch geometry before filtering and score-hook geometry mutations, refresh reward only at the established hook boundary, and keep sequential branch state transitions intact.
Preserve full group-LOO completion requirements, UTF-8 private prompt bytes and model token positions; cancelled/failed siblings never become critic peers or TETHER observations.
TETHER uses native sampled-mask provenance for shared-prefix positioning and deduplicated masks for fitting; new canonical trainability/weight streams must not redefine this implicitly.
Publish copied critic targets/returns/versions before actor filtering or graph release; preserve existing cold replay and scheduler provenance semantics.
why_not_now: This is a qualitatively larger compatibility migration with real removed APIs and tokenization changes. The remaining current-stack DCP metadata bug is independently useful, small, and testable without destabilizing six completed units. Preparing the coherent next branch is meaningful progress; shipping a partial consumer-only provenance stub is not.
limitations: No proposed stack has been installed or executed. No universal environment compatibility claim. Local exact Git objects were inspected; no web/runtime verification was needed for source-only conclusions.
recommended_first_increment: See native-rg-first-unit.json: add native RG TaskData on current b13 before any backend upgrade; retain existing legacy routes. This is useful bounded implementation, not a reason to stop because the broader stack is large.
